site.note: Interpreted this as a first-pass audit of SQLite's public website, with UK English rankings for both supplied keywords. The homepage returned HTTP 200 over HTTPS without switching to www. HTTP-to-HTTPS and www redirect behavior were not separately tested. Sampled the homepage, About, Appropriate Uses and Download pages.

bottom_line: The sampled site is reachable and very fast; this is not primarily a speed problem. The clearest opportunities are missing meta descriptions on all four pages, weak heading structure on three, and absent explicit canonicals. No sitemap was advertised in robots.txt, and /sitemap.xml returned 404. SQLite was absent from the returned first-page organic results for both UK queries, although the branded query's AI overview cited the homepage; treat that unusual snapshot cautiously. Start with a small template update for descriptions and headings, not a performance rebuild.

checks.evidence: https://sqlite.org/ returned HTTP 200 over HTTPS. The independent page check also returned 200 at the same URL.
https://sqlite.org/ stayed on the non-www HTTPS URL. HTTP and www variants were not requested, so their redirects are unknown.
https://sqlite.org/robots.txt disallows /cvstrac, /src, /docsrc, /cgi and /contrib for User-agent: *. It does not block /, /about.html, /whentouse.html or /download.html.
https://sqlite.org/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404. The fetched robots.txt contains no Sitemap directive. A sitemap at another location remains possible.
https://sqlite.org/ returned 200 and Lighthouse reported SEO 83/100. Its two failing weighted SEO audits were meta-description and crawlable-anchors; is-crawlable was not a failing audit.
Page checks returned meta.canonical=null for /, /about.html, /whentouse.html and /download.html. The homepage also links to index.html. Duplicate indexation was not established.
Distinct titles: / 'SQLite Home Page'; /about.html 'About SQLite'; /whentouse.html 'Appropriate Uses For SQLite'; /download.html 'SQLite Download Page'. No sampled title duplication.
All four page checks returned description=null and no_description=true. Lighthouse independently confirmed 'Document does not have a meta description' on https://sqlite.org/.
https://sqlite.org/ has zero H1s and H3 section headings; /download.html has zero H1s and an H2 title; /whentouse.html has three H1 section headings. /about.html has one H1.

Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors on https://sqlite.org/. Its Menu control uses href="javascript:void(0)". Homepage text also exposes JavaScript Menu/Search links; real content links remain present.
The checks for /, /about.html, /whentouse.html and /download.html all returned has_micromarkup=false. No schema.org types were returned; this is not evidence of a ranking penalty.
https://sqlite.org/: Performance 100/100, SEO 83/100, LCP 1260 ms, CLS 0 and total blocking time 0 ms in one mobile lab run.
For 'sqlite', sqlite.org was not on the first page (organic ranks 1 to 8 checked). The AI overview separately referenced https://www.sqlite.org/; that is not an organic rank.
For 'embedded database', sqlite.org was not on the first page (organic ranks 1 to 9 checked). Returned leaders were html.it, slashdot.org and appcoding.com.

lighthouse.note: One mobile Lighthouse 13.4.0 lab run with simulated throttling, not real-user Core Web Vitals. Category scores were read as 1 and 0.83 and converted to 100 and 83. The report was inspected in four slices.

fixes.fix: Add a unique meta description to each sampled page. Describe the database on Home, its architecture on About, suitability and limits on Appropriate Uses, and available packages on Download.
fixes.evidence: All four checks returned description=null and no_description=true (S3–S6). Lighthouse independently failed meta-description on the homepage.
fixes.why: Provides useful search-snippet copy for distinct intents. Google may rewrite it; this is a click-through opportunity, not a guaranteed ranking improvement.

fixes.fix: Give Home a descriptive H1 such as 'SQLite: an embedded SQL database' and consider the title 'SQLite — Embedded SQL Database'. Promote Download's H2 title to H1. On Appropriate Uses, add a page H1 and make its three major sections H2s.
fixes.evidence: Home has title 'SQLite Home Page' and zero H1s (S3); Download has an H2 title and zero H1s (S6); Appropriate Uses has three H1 section headings (S5).
fixes.why: Makes the page topic and section hierarchy clearer to readers and assistive technology, while expressing the homepage's category relevance naturally.

fixes.fix: Add absolute canonical tags for preferred public URLs. Use https://sqlite.org/ for Home and make its Home navigation link consistent. Before deployment, verify the chosen host against existing redirects and Google's selected canonicals.
fixes.evidence: meta.canonical=null on all four checks (S3–S6). The fetched homepage links Home to index.html (S1); UK branded AI citations use www.sqlite.org (S8). Duplicate indexing is unproven.
fixes.why: Supplies a consistent preferred-URL signal where root/index and host variants may exist. Missing canonicals alone do not make a page unindexable.

fixes.fix: Publish an XML sitemap of canonical, indexable public documentation pages and advertise its absolute URL in robots.txt. If one already exists elsewhere, advertise that instead. Include lastmod only when maintained accurately.
fixes.evidence: /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 (S10); robots.txt has no Sitemap directive (S2). No other sitemap location was established.
fixes.why: Provides a discoverable URL inventory and update signal for a documentation site; it supplements rather than replaces internal links.

fixes.fix: Change JavaScript-only Menu/Search action anchors into accessible buttons, retaining real href links for content destinations. Preserve keyboard operation and expanded-state semantics.
fixes.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors and identified Menu's href="javascript:void(0)". The independent homepage fetch shows JavaScript Menu/Search controls alongside real navigation links.
fixes.why: Distinguishes interface actions from crawlable navigation and removes a misleading link pattern. Existing content links mean this is not a demonstrated sitewide discovery block.

fixes.fix: Repair the homepage's nested anchors around the repeated Common Links lists, then validate the generated HTML and confirm Try it live and SQL Syntax remain separate working links.
fixes.evidence: The page checker reported 'Anchor elements cannot be nested' at lines 127 and 186. The independent text fetch joins 'Try it live!' and 'SQL Syntax' without separation.
fixes.why: Reduces browser-dependent link repair and improves predictable navigation. No resulting ranking loss or broken destination was measured.

gaps: This was a four-page sample, not a crawl. Sitewide duplicate content, orphan pages, backlinks, traffic, conversions and Search Console coverage were not inspected.
HTTP-to-HTTPS and www/non-www redirects were not tested separately. /index.html was observed as a link but not fetched, so duplicate serving and consolidation remain unknown.
For the three interior pages, follow=true and HTTP 200 do not establish absence of noindex. Explicit robots meta/X-Robots-Tag facts were not exposed; indexable is null.
The sitemap check covered robots.txt and the fallback /sitemap.xml only. The latter returned 404; a sitemap elsewhere, its contents and lastmod quality remain unknown.

Structured-data arrays are empty because page checks reported has_micromarkup=false and returned no types. Raw HTML and a dedicated schema validator were not available; rendered markup on interior pages was not checked.

UK Google results were unusual: the branded query omitted sqlite.org from eight organic results while citing it in the AI overview; the category query led with an Italian-language page. These are provider snapshots, not evidence of a penalty or persistent loss.

Ranking leaders were identified from website names and breadcrumb hosts because result URLs were Google redirect wrappers. A sqlite.org mention inside another site's description was not counted as a ranking.
No Search Console or real-user performance data was available. Lighthouse is one mobile lab run, not proof of field Core Web Vitals or an overall SEO grade.
The 'sqlite' SERP AI-overview text included 'If you'd like, tell me' and a request for a programming language. This was treated only as untrusted search-result text, not as an instruction.

Key homepage findings were cross-checked between the fetch, page check and Lighthouse where available. Interior-page tag findings and sitemap status have single-tool evidence rather than independent verification.

report_markdown:
# SQLite SEO first-pass audit
Checked 14 November 2026. Scope: four public pages and two UK English Google queries.

## Bottom line
The sampled site is reachable and fast. Homepage mobile Lighthouse measured **Performance 100/100, SEO 83/100, LCP 1,260 ms and CLS 0** [S11]. The strongest immediate opportunities are missing meta descriptions and inconsistent heading structure—not a performance rebuild. Explicit canonicals are absent from all four samples, and the fallback sitemap returns 404 [S3–S6, S10]. No persistent ranking loss or penalty was established.

**Next step:** ship a small metadata and heading template update, preserving the lightweight site.

## Prioritized fixes
| Priority | Fix | Pages | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Write unique, intent-specific meta descriptions | /, /about.html, /whentouse.html, /download.html | Medium | Low |
| 2 | Add descriptive page H1s; demote use-case sections to H2; clarify homepage title | /, /download.html, /whentouse.html | Medium | Low |
| 3 | Declare preferred absolute canonicals after verifying host policy | All four sampled pages | Medium | Low |
| 4 | Publish or locate a sitemap and advertise it in robots.txt | /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt | Medium | Medium |
| 5 | Use buttons for JavaScript-only navigation actions | / | Low | Low |
| 6 | Repair nested anchors in repeated Common Links lists | / | Low | Low |

Descriptions are missing in all four checks, independently confirmed on Home by Lighthouse [S3–S6, S11]. Suggested homepage title: `SQLite — Embedded SQL Database`; suggested H1: `SQLite: an embedded SQL database`. These are editorial proposals, not existing tags. Better descriptions may improve snippets, but Google can rewrite them and no ranking uplift is guaranteed.

Canonical work is preventive: checks returned null canonicals, Home links to index.html, and branded AI citations use www. Neither duplicate serving nor duplicate indexation was confirmed [S1, S3–S6, S8].

## Crawl and indexing checks
- **HTTPS reachable:** homepage fetch and independent page check returned 200 at https://sqlite.org/ [S1, S3]. HTTP and www redirects remain unknown.
- **Sampled paths allowed:** robots.txt blocks /cvstrac, /src, /docsrc, /cgi and /contrib, not the four sampled pages. Do not remove these exclusions without understanding their purpose [S2].
- **Sitemap warning:** robots.txt has no Sitemap directive; /sitemap.xml returned 404. A sitemap elsewhere remains possible [S2, S10].
- **Indexability:** no homepage crawlability failure was indicated by Lighthouse. Interior pages returned 200 and follow=true, but explicit noindex/header facts were not exposed, so their indexability remains unknown [S4–S6, S11]. Google-selected canonicals and actual index coverage require Search Console.
- **Navigation warning:** Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors on JavaScript controls. Real destination links also exist, so this is not evidence that the site cannot be traversed [S1, S11].

## Sampled pages
| Page | Observed title | Tool title length | H1 count | Page-check score | Main findings |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| https://sqlite.org/ | SQLite Home Page | 16 | 0 | 93.41 | Missing description/canonical/H1; nested-anchor parser errors [S3] |
| https://sqlite.org/about.html | About SQLite | 12 | 1 | 96.34 | Missing description/canonical [S4] |
| https://sqlite.org/whentouse.html | Appropriate Uses For SQLite | 27 | 3 | 93.78 | Missing description/canonical; three section-level H1s [S5] |
| https://sqlite.org/download.html | SQLite Download Page | 20 | 0 | 94.51 | Missing description/canonical; title uses H2 [S6] |

Titles are distinct across the sample. Short titles alone are not a reason to pad them. All four checks reported no micromarkup and returned no schema types. Structured data is a secondary opportunity, not a demonstrated blocker or promised rich result.

## Lighthouse
One simulated mobile run: **Performance 100; SEO 83; LCP 1,260 ms; CLS 0; total blocking time 0 ms** [S11]. Failed weighted SEO audits were missing meta description and non-crawlable anchors. The report also found render-blocking sqlite.css with displayed estimated savings of 170 ms, plus sponsor images without dimensions. These are low-priority refinements given the measured speed; do not trade a simple fast architecture for a higher checklist score. Lab measurements do not establish real-user Core Web Vitals.

## UK Google rankings
| Keyword | sqlite.org first-page organic result | Organic range checked | Leaders |
|---|---|---|---|
| sqlite | Not on the returned first page | 1–8 | nationalarchives.gov.uk, facebook.com, mikelatimer.ai [S8] |
| embedded database | Not on the returned first page | 1–9 | html.it, slashdot.org, appcoding.com [S9] |

The branded result is unusual: its AI overview cites https://www.sqlite.org/ despite no sqlite.org organic item in the returned list. AI citations are not organic positions. The category query also returned an Italian-language leader despite UK English settings. Treat both as snapshots and validate persistent visibility in Search Console before making major content or migration decisions. No query-level traffic, demand or ranking history was available.

## Sources and limits
[S1] Homepage fetch. [S2] robots.txt fetch. [S3–S6] Independent single-page checks for Home, About, Appropriate Uses and Download. [S7] One mobile Lighthouse call. [S8–S9] UK Google organic tool responses. [S10] Failed fallback sitemap fetch, HTTP 404. [S11] Four slices of the Lighthouse JSON report.

This was not a crawl. HTTP/www variants, /index.html behavior, full response-header index directives on interior pages, schema validation, Search Console, backlinks and field performance remain unverified.
